additional_info.subject: ID0383375-DC/Si-D/GR[170000204] - Connector 1 & 2 unavailable CRM:00315001888
additional_info.body:
Dear Nikolaos,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / ND 170000204
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
vqjBHw
Problem Description
: Connector 1 and 2 are unavailable
Troubleshooting
:
For the timestamp you provided to me, DC2's SECC had a very short communication timeout while the plug in was performed.
It recovered in less than 1 sec but since the EV was plugged in, it didn't work as intended.
After the plug out and plug back in, the session worked (1min20secs later)
Then at:
Which is the same error I showed above and recovered 4secs later.
It's planned that in the new firmware version v6.X, this error is fixed.
Since this error only occurs for the duration that it's expected (see the first photo "no reply in 4.25sec), it's not needed to replace the component.
For now, if this error occurs just wait 4 sec and it will work again.
I hope I was clear in my information, please let me know your thoughts and doubts.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0383375
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
